description: UtilityCraft: Digital Storage v1.0.1 adds safer native storage for unstackable items, automatic vault recovery and a more capable Export Buffer.
highlights:
- Preserve add-on data, bundle and shulker contents, durability, enchantments and other opaque data on unstackable items.
- Recover missing vault pages from rotating backups without pausing unrelated storage operations.
- Keep existing plain item keys and full item definitions compatible and extractable.
- Export Buffers now map each filter to its three output slots, merge partial stacks and skip blocked columns.
